en: A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a woman standing indoors wearing an elaborate traditional folk costume, including a long embroidered dress, apron, and head covering. There is ornate furniture and a column or pedestal behind her. Along the right edge appears printed caption text in French and English, and a circular stamp-like emblem is visible on the left side. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom.
